blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance for Algonquin's Newer Neighborhoods
blocks.intro: The Fox River runs right through Algonquin. In April 2013, it reached a record crest of 12.70 feet here, and in July 2017 volunteers filled more than 25,000 sandbags.

items.body: In subdivisions built in the 1990s and 2000s, trees are only now big enough to find sewer joints. Catching it early keeps a small root problem from becoming a backup.
When the Fox River is high, groundwater adds load. A clean line handles it better.
If you have a backflow valve or [overhead sewer system](/algonquin/overhead-sewer-systems), we test it on the same visit.

blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/algonquin/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/algonquin/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/algonquin/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/algonquin/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/algonquin/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: My line has never had a problem. Should I bother?
items.preview: A one-time camera check is a smart baseline.
items.answer: A single camera check is a smart baseline for a line that's 20 years or older. If it's clean, you may not need a schedule at all.

items.preview: Rodding for roots, jetting for grease and scale.
items.answer: Rodding handles yearly root control. Jetting is better for grease and scale or when roots return quickly.

items.preview: It helps, but an overloaded sewer needs other protection.
items.answer: A clean line drains faster. If the public sewer is overloaded, you need a backflow valve or [overhead sewer](/algonquin/overhead-sewer-systems).

items.q: Is this part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The No Drip Club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club/) brings a plumber to your home for regular maintenance. Ask how it applies to your sewer line.

items.q: What does sewer maintenance cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on the service. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on whether your line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. We quote a flat rate before we start.
